# Purpose

This notebook calculates time-weighted relative quoted spreads from WRDS Daily
TAQ `complete_nbbo` tables. Each input row identifies one ETF, one trading date,
and one event-time anchor. The output contains one observation for each requested
event-time window.

The relative quoted spread is measured in basis points:

\[
10{,}000 \times \frac{Ask-Bid}{(Ask+Bid)/2}.
\]

Locked quotes (`bid = ask`) are retained and contribute a zero spread in the
main specification and are excluded in the alternative specification. Crossed,
invalid, and ambiguous-price quotes are excluded only for the time for which
they are active. The previous quote is never carried forward across an excluded
interval. The notebook also calculates one-cent spread percentages and displayed
bid and ask depth.

# 1. Package setup

Install the required packages once.
```{r install-packages, eval=FALSE}
install.packages(c("data.table", "DBI", "RPostgres"))
```

Load `data.table`
```{r setup, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(error = FALSE)
library(data.table)
```

# 2. Define the event-time windows

The analysis uses seven non-overlapping windows relative to `anchor_time`. The
left endpoint is included and the right endpoint is excluded.

```{r define-windows}
WINDOWS <- data.table(
  window = c(
    "m30_m10", "m10_0", "0_1", "1_5", "5_10", "10_15", "15_20"
  ),
  start_min = c(-30, -10, 0, 1, 5, 10, 15),
  end_min = c(-10, 0, 1, 5, 10, 15, 20)
)

COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_PCT <- 99
STRICT_COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_PCT <- 99.9
ONE_CENT_TOLERANCE_DOLLARS <- 1e-7

WINDOWS
```

# 3. Time conversion functions

WRDS stores quote times as clock times, while the weighting calculation is
easier in seconds after midnight. These functions convert between the two
representations and reject invalid times.

```{r time-functions}
clock_to_seconds <- function(x) {
  parts <- strsplit(as.character(x), ":", fixed = TRUE)[[1L]]
  if (length(parts) != 3L) stop("anchor_time must be HH:MM:SS")

  values <- suppressWarnings(as.numeric(parts))
  if (anyNA(values) ||
      values[1L] < 0 || values[1L] >= 24 ||
      values[2L] < 0 || values[2L] >= 60 ||
      values[3L] < 0 || values[3L] >= 60) {
    stop("Invalid anchor_time: ", x)
  }

  values[1L] * 3600 + values[2L] * 60 + values[3L]
}

seconds_to_clock <- function(x) {
  if (x < 0 || x >= 86400) stop("Requested windows cross midnight")

  h <- floor(x / 3600)
  m <- floor((x %% 3600) / 60)
  s <- x %% 60

  sprintf("%02d:%02d:%09.6f", h, m, s)
}
```

# 4. Read and validate the input file

The input CSV must contain `ticker`, `date`, `anchor_time`, `day_type`, and
`matched_event_date`. Validation is performed before any WRDS query begins.

```{r validate-input-function}
validate_input <- function(x) {
  required <- c(
    "ticker", "date", "anchor_time", "day_type", "matched_event_date"
  )

  missing_cols <- setdiff(required, names(x))
  if (length(missing_cols)) {
    stop("Input is missing columns: ", paste(missing_cols, collapse = ", "))
  }

  x[, input_row := .I]
  x[, ticker := toupper(trimws(as.character(ticker)))]
  x[, date := as.IDate(date)]
  x[, matched_event_date := as.IDate(matched_event_date)]
  x[, anchor_time := trimws(as.character(anchor_time))]
  x[, day_type := tolower(trimws(as.character(day_type)))]

  if (anyNA(x$date)) {
    stop("At least one date is invalid; use YYYY-MM-DD")
  }
  if (anyNA(x$matched_event_date)) {
    stop("At least one matched_event_date is invalid")
  }
  if (any(!x$day_type %chin% c("event", "comparison"))) {
    stop("day_type must be event or comparison")
  }
  if (any(!grepl("^[A-Z0-9-]{1,15}$", x$ticker))) {
    stop("ticker must be a root ticker without a suffix")
  }

  x
}
```

The example below loads the provided XLK test row. Replace the path with the
full research input file when it is ready.

```{r read-input, eval=FALSE}
input_file <- file.choose()
input <- validate_input(fread(input_file, colClasses = "character"))
input
```

Credentials should never be typed into this notebook or committed to GitHub.
Run the following commands once in the R console after replacing the


# 6. Connect to WRDS

This function reads the credentials from environment variables and opens an
encrypted PostgreSQL connection to WRDS. It stops with a clear message if the
credentials or packages are missing.

```{r connect-function}
connect_wrds <- function() {
  if (!requireNamespace("DBI", quietly = TRUE) ||
      !requireNamespace("RPostgres", quietly = TRUE)) {
    stop("Install DBI and RPostgres before connecting to WRDS")
  }

  user <- Sys.getenv("WRDS_USER")
  password <- Sys.getenv("WRDS_PASSWORD")

  if (!nzchar(user) || !nzchar(password)) {
    stop("Set WRDS_USER and WRDS_PASSWORD in ~/.Renviron, then restart R")
  }

  DBI::dbConnect(
    RPostgres::Postgres(),
    host = "wrds-pgdata.wharton.upenn.edu",
    port = 9737,
    dbname = "wrds",
    sslmode = "require",
    user = user,
    password = password
  )
}
```

Open the connection only when a live WRDS query is required. This chunk is
disabled during knitting so that the report can be rendered offline.

```{r open-connection, eval=FALSE}
con <- connect_wrds()
```

# 7. Pull complete-NBBO quotes and displayed depth

For a given ticker and date, this function queries the corresponding daily
table, such as `taqm_2019.complete_nbbo_20190130`.

`time_m` stores the microsecond timestamp and `time_m_nano` stores the remaining
three nanosecond digits. They are retained separately for equality checks and
combined when durations are calculated. The depth fields
`best_bidsizeshares` and `best_asksizeshares` are measured in shares. They are
the displayed sizes of the quote credited with setting each side of the NBBO,
not aggregate depth across all exchanges at the best price.

The query retrieves both:

1. The last quote at or before the first window boundary, so a quote already
   active at the boundary is included.
2. Every quote update inside the requested period.

```{r fetch-quotes-function}
fetch_complete_nbbo <- function(con, ticker, date, start_sec, end_sec) {
  year <- format(as.IDate(date), "%Y")
  ymd <- format(as.IDate(date), "%Y%m%d")
  schema <- paste0("taqm_", year)
  table <- paste0("complete_nbbo_", ymd)

  start_clock <- seconds_to_clock(start_sec)
  end_clock <- seconds_to_clock(end_sec)

  sql <- sprintf(
    paste(
      "WITH prior_key AS (",
      "  SELECT time_m, COALESCE(time_m_nano, 0) AS time_m_nano",
      "  FROM %s.%s",
      "  WHERE sym_root = %s",
      "    AND COALESCE(sym_suffix, '') = ''",
      "    AND (time_m < TIME %s OR",
      "         (time_m = TIME %s AND COALESCE(time_m_nano, 0) = 0))",
      "  ORDER BY time_m DESC, COALESCE(time_m_nano, 0) DESC",
      "  LIMIT 1",
      "), prior AS (",
      "  SELECT q.date, q.time_m, COALESCE(q.time_m_nano, 0) AS time_m_nano,",
      "         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM q.time_m)::double precision +",
      "           COALESCE(q.time_m_nano, 0)::double precision / 1000000000",
      "           AS time_sec,",
      "         q.sym_root, q.qu_cond, q.natbbo_ind, q.qu_source,",
      "         q.nbbo_qu_cond,",
      "         q.best_bid::double precision AS best_bid,",
      "         q.best_bidsizeshares::double precision AS best_bidsizeshares,",
      "         q.best_ask::double precision AS best_ask,",
      "         q.best_asksizeshares::double precision AS best_asksizeshares",
      "  FROM %s.%s q",
      "  INNER JOIN prior_key p",
      "    ON q.time_m = p.time_m",
      "   AND COALESCE(q.time_m_nano, 0) = p.time_m_nano",
      "  WHERE q.sym_root = %s",
      "    AND COALESCE(q.sym_suffix, '') = ''",
      "), inside_window AS (",
      "  SELECT date, time_m, COALESCE(time_m_nano, 0) AS time_m_nano,",
      "         EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM time_m)::double precision +",
      "           COALESCE(time_m_nano, 0)::double precision / 1000000000",
      "           AS time_sec,",
      "         sym_root, qu_cond, natbbo_ind, qu_source, nbbo_qu_cond,",
      "         best_bid::double precision AS best_bid,",
      "         best_bidsizeshares::double precision AS best_bidsizeshares,",
      "         best_ask::double precision AS best_ask,",
      "         best_asksizeshares::double precision AS best_asksizeshares",
      "  FROM %s.%s",
      "  WHERE sym_root = %s",
      "    AND COALESCE(sym_suffix, '') = ''",
      "    AND (time_m > TIME %s OR",
      "         (time_m = TIME %s AND COALESCE(time_m_nano, 0) > 0))",
      "    AND time_m < TIME %s",
      ")",
      "SELECT * FROM prior",
      "UNION ALL",
      "SELECT * FROM inside_window",
      "ORDER BY time_m, time_m_nano",
      sep = "\n"
    ),
    schema,
    table,
    DBI::dbQuoteString(con, ticker),
    DBI::dbQuoteString(con, start_clock),
    DBI::dbQuoteString(con, start_clock),
    schema,
    table,
    DBI::dbQuoteString(con, ticker),
    schema,
    table,
    DBI::dbQuoteString(con, ticker),
    DBI::dbQuoteString(con, start_clock),
    DBI::dbQuoteString(con, start_clock),
    DBI::dbQuoteString(con, end_clock)
  )

  as.data.table(DBI::dbGetQuery(con, sql))
}
```

# 8. Classify each quote state

Each two-sided quote is assigned to one diagnostic category. Valid and locked
quotes are used in the spread calculation. Crossed, missing, and non-positive
quotes are excluded and their durations are reported.

The inspected WRDS `complete_nbbo` table retains `qu_cond`, `natbbo_ind`,
`qu_source`, and `nbbo_qu_cond`, but it has no separate cancellation/correction
field and no sequence field. NYSE documentation says quote condition determines
whether a source quote qualifies for BBO calculation, while the NBBO file
records quotes that cause the NBBO to change. Accordingly, this notebook uses
the constructed best bid and ask supplied by `complete_nbbo` and does not apply
an additional quote-condition filter. A cancellation or correction that changes
the NBBO is represented by a subsequent state update; the notebook does not
attempt to reconstruct an unavailable cancellation flag.

```{r classify-function}
classify_state <- function(bid, ask) {
  fcase(
    is.na(bid) | is.na(ask),
    "missing_price",

    !is.finite(bid) | !is.finite(ask) | bid <= 0 | ask <= 0,
    "invalid_price",

    bid > ask,
    "crossed",

    bid == ask,
    "locked",

    bid < ask,
    "valid",

    default = "invalid_price"
  )
}
```

# 9. Convert quotes into active states

Each quote is active from its timestamp until the next quote update. The final
quote already active at 30 minutes before the anchor is carried into the first
minute. Distinct nanosecond updates are retained even when they share the same
`time_m` value.

Rows are collapsed only when both `time_m` and `time_m_nano` agree. If their bid
and ask prices conflict, that timestamp becomes an `ambiguous_price` state and
its active duration is excluded. If prices agree but a side's sizes conflict,
the spread remains usable while depth on only that side is marked ambiguous and
excluded. Crossed or otherwise excluded quotes are never replaced with an older
valid quote.

```{r prepare-states-function}
prepare_quote_states <- function(quotes, anchor_sec) {
  global_start <- anchor_sec - 30 * 60
  global_end <- anchor_sec + 20 * 60

  quotes <- copy(as.data.table(quotes))
  quotes <- quotes[is.finite(time_sec) & time_sec < global_end]
  if (!"time_m_nano" %in% names(quotes)) quotes[, time_m_nano := 0L]
  if (!"best_bidsizeshares" %in% names(quotes)) {
    quotes[, best_bidsizeshares := NA_real_]
  }
  if (!"best_asksizeshares" %in% names(quotes)) {
    quotes[, best_asksizeshares := NA_real_]
  }

  if (all(c("time_m", "time_m_nano") %in% names(quotes))) {
    quotes[, timestamp_key := paste(as.character(time_m), time_m_nano, sep = "|")]
    setorder(quotes, time_m, time_m_nano)
  } else {
    quotes[, timestamp_key := sprintf("%.9f", time_sec)]
    setorder(quotes, time_sec)
  }

  collapse_timestamp <- function(x) {
    price_pairs <- unique(x[, .(best_bid, best_ask)])
    ambiguous_price <- nrow(price_pairs) != 1L
    bid_size_agrees <- uniqueN(x$best_bidsizeshares, na.rm = FALSE) == 1L
    ask_size_agrees <- uniqueN(x$best_asksizeshares, na.rm = FALSE) == 1L

    data.table(
      time_sec = x$time_sec[1L],
      best_bid = if (ambiguous_price) NA_real_ else x$best_bid[1L],
      best_ask = if (ambiguous_price) NA_real_ else x$best_ask[1L],
      best_bidsizeshares = if (!ambiguous_price && bid_size_agrees) {
        x$best_bidsizeshares[1L]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      best_asksizeshares = if (!ambiguous_price && ask_size_agrees) {
        x$best_asksizeshares[1L]
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      ambiguous_price = ambiguous_price,
      bid_depth_ambiguous = ambiguous_price || !bid_size_agrees,
      ask_depth_ambiguous = ambiguous_price || !ask_size_agrees
    )
  }

  if (nrow(quotes)) {
    quotes <- quotes[, collapse_timestamp(.SD), by = timestamp_key]
    setorder(quotes, time_sec)
  }

  if (!nrow(quotes)) {
    return(data.table(
      state_start = global_start,
      state_end = global_end,
      state = "missing_quote",
      spread_bps = NA_real_,
      dollar_spread = NA_real_,
      bid_depth_shares = NA_real_,
      ask_depth_shares = NA_real_,
      bid_depth_ambiguous = FALSE,
      ask_depth_ambiguous = FALSE,
      large_spread = FALSE
    ))
  }

  quotes[, state_start := pmax(time_sec, global_start)]
  quotes[, state_end := shift(time_sec, type = "lead", fill = global_end)]
  quotes[, state_end := pmin(state_end, global_end)]
  quotes <- quotes[state_end > state_start]
  quotes[, state := fifelse(
    ambiguous_price,
    "ambiguous_price",
    classify_state(best_bid, best_ask)
  )]
  quotes[, dollar_spread := fifelse(
    state %chin% c("valid", "locked"),
    best_ask - best_bid,
    NA_real_
  )]
  quotes[, spread_bps := fifelse(
    state %chin% c("valid", "locked"),
    10000 * (best_ask - best_bid) / ((best_ask + best_bid) / 2),
    NA_real_
  )]
  quotes[, large_spread := !is.na(spread_bps) & spread_bps > 100]
  quotes[, bid_depth_shares := fifelse(
    !bid_depth_ambiguous & is.finite(best_bidsizeshares) &
      best_bidsizeshares > 0,
    best_bidsizeshares,
    NA_real_
  )]
  quotes[, ask_depth_shares := fifelse(
    !ask_depth_ambiguous & is.finite(best_asksizeshares) &
      best_asksizeshares > 0,
    best_asksizeshares,
    NA_real_
  )]

  states <- quotes[, .(
    state_start, state_end, state, spread_bps, dollar_spread,
    bid_depth_shares, ask_depth_shares,
    bid_depth_ambiguous, ask_depth_ambiguous, large_spread
  )]

  if (!nrow(states) || states$state_start[1L] > global_start) {
    first_start <- if (nrow(states)) states$state_start[1L] else global_end
    states <- rbind(
      data.table(
        state_start = global_start,
        state_end = first_start,
        state = "missing_quote",
        spread_bps = NA_real_,
        dollar_spread = NA_real_,
        bid_depth_shares = NA_real_,
        ask_depth_shares = NA_real_,
        bid_depth_ambiguous = FALSE,
        ask_depth_ambiguous = FALSE,
        large_spread = FALSE
      ),
      states
    )
  }

  states
}
```

# 10. Calculate 50 one-minute spreads

The graph dataset contains one time-weighted observation for every minute from
`-30` through `+19`, giving 50 minutes per ETF-date. Two versions are produced:

- `keep_locked`: locked quotes are valid and contribute a zero spread;
- `exclude_locked`: locked duration is removed from the robustness calculation.

`coverage_pct` is the percentage of the minute with a spread eligible under the
selected treatment. One-cent diagnostics use the same spread-usable seconds.
Bid and ask depth have separate usable seconds and coverage because one side's
size may be missing, nonpositive, or ambiguous while the other side remains
usable.

```{r calculate-minute-spreads-function}
calculate_one_minute_spreads <- function(
    states,
    anchor_sec,
    include_locked = TRUE) {

  minute_starts <- -30:19
  locked_treatment <- if (include_locked) "keep_locked" else "exclude_locked"
  eligible_states <- if (include_locked) c("valid", "locked") else "valid"

  rbindlist(lapply(minute_starts, function(minute_start_min) {
    minute_start <- anchor_sec + minute_start_min * 60
    minute_end <- minute_start + 60

    overlap <- states[
      state_end > minute_start & state_start < minute_end,
      .(
        state,
        spread_bps,
        dollar_spread,
        bid_depth_shares,
        ask_depth_shares,
        bid_depth_ambiguous,
        ask_depth_ambiguous,
        large_spread,
        seconds = pmax(
          0,
          pmin(state_end, minute_end) - pmax(state_start, minute_start)
        )
      )
    ][seconds > 0]

    duration_for <- function(label) sum(overlap[state == label, seconds])
    valid_seconds <- duration_for("valid")
    locked_seconds <- duration_for("locked")
    eligible_seconds <- sum(overlap[state %chin% eligible_states, seconds])

    spread_numerator <- sum(
      overlap[state %chin% eligible_states, spread_bps * seconds],
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    one_cent_seconds <- sum(overlap[
      state %chin% eligible_states &
        !is.na(dollar_spread) &
        abs(dollar_spread - 0.01) <= ONE_CENT_TOLERANCE_DOLLARS,
      seconds
    ])
    large_spread_seconds <- sum(overlap[
      state %chin% eligible_states & large_spread,
      seconds
    ])

    bid_depth_usable <- overlap[
      state %chin% eligible_states & !is.na(bid_depth_shares)
    ]
    ask_depth_usable <- overlap[
      state %chin% eligible_states & !is.na(ask_depth_shares)
    ]
    bid_depth_usable_seconds <- sum(bid_depth_usable$seconds)
    ask_depth_usable_seconds <- sum(ask_depth_usable$seconds)
    bid_depth_numerator <- sum(
      bid_depth_usable$bid_depth_shares * bid_depth_usable$seconds,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    ask_depth_numerator <- sum(
      ask_depth_usable$ask_depth_shares * ask_depth_usable$seconds,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )

    bid_depth_ambiguous_seconds <- sum(
      overlap[bid_depth_ambiguous == TRUE, seconds]
    )
    ask_depth_ambiguous_seconds <- sum(
      overlap[ask_depth_ambiguous == TRUE, seconds]
    )
    bid_depth_invalid_size_seconds <- sum(overlap[
      state %chin% eligible_states &
        !bid_depth_ambiguous & is.na(bid_depth_shares),
      seconds
    ])
    ask_depth_invalid_size_seconds <- sum(overlap[
      state %chin% eligible_states &
        !ask_depth_ambiguous & is.na(ask_depth_shares),
      seconds
    ])

    quote_coverage_seconds <- valid_seconds + locked_seconds
    coverage_pct <- 100 * eligible_seconds / 60

    data.table(
      locked_treatment = locked_treatment,
      minute_start_min = minute_start_min,
      minute_end_min = minute_start_min + 1L,
      tw_relative_quoted_spread_bps = if (eligible_seconds > 0) {
        spread_numerator / eligible_seconds
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      one_cent_seconds = one_cent_seconds,
      one_cent_pct = if (eligible_seconds > 0) {
        100 * one_cent_seconds / eligible_seconds
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      tw_bid_depth_shares = if (bid_depth_usable_seconds > 0) {
        bid_depth_numerator / bid_depth_usable_seconds
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      tw_ask_depth_shares = if (ask_depth_usable_seconds > 0) {
        ask_depth_numerator / ask_depth_usable_seconds
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      valid_seconds = valid_seconds,
      locked_seconds = locked_seconds,
      crossed_seconds = duration_for("crossed"),
      missing_quote_seconds = duration_for("missing_quote"),
      missing_price_seconds = duration_for("missing_price"),
      invalid_price_seconds = duration_for("invalid_price"),
      ambiguous_price_seconds = duration_for("ambiguous_price"),
      large_spread_seconds = large_spread_seconds,
      eligible_seconds = eligible_seconds,
      excluded_seconds = 60 - eligible_seconds,
      coverage_pct = coverage_pct,
      passes_coverage = eligible_seconds > 0 &
        coverage_pct + 1e-10 >= COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_PCT,
      passes_strict_coverage = eligible_seconds > 0 &
        coverage_pct + 1e-10 >= STRICT_COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_PCT,
      quote_coverage_pct = 100 * quote_coverage_seconds / 60,
      calculation_coverage_pct = coverage_pct,
      complete_quote_coverage = abs(quote_coverage_seconds - 60) < 1e-7,
      complete_calculation_coverage = abs(eligible_seconds - 60) < 1e-7,
      bid_depth_usable_seconds = bid_depth_usable_seconds,
      ask_depth_usable_seconds = ask_depth_usable_seconds,
      bid_depth_coverage_pct = 100 * bid_depth_usable_seconds / 60,
      ask_depth_coverage_pct = 100 * ask_depth_usable_seconds / 60,
      bid_depth_ambiguous_seconds = bid_depth_ambiguous_seconds,
      ask_depth_ambiguous_seconds = ask_depth_ambiguous_seconds,
      bid_depth_invalid_size_seconds = bid_depth_invalid_size_seconds,
      ask_depth_invalid_size_seconds = ask_depth_invalid_size_seconds
    )
  }))
}
```

# 11. Construct research windows

The minute spreads remain the descriptive graph series. Research-window spreads
are recomputed using usable seconds rather than taking an unweighted mean of
minute averages:

\[
Window\ Spread =
\frac{\sum_m Minute\ Spread_m \times Usable\ Seconds_m}
     {\sum_m Usable\ Seconds_m}.
\]

Minutes with zero usable seconds contribute to neither the numerator nor the
denominator. `regression_spread_bps` uses this window measure when coverage is
at least 99%. The 99.9% flag is retained for a stricter sensitivity check.

```{r aggregate-minute-windows-function}
aggregate_minute_windows <- function(minute_results) {
  rbindlist(lapply(seq_len(nrow(WINDOWS)), function(i) {
    w <- WINDOWS[i]
    x <- minute_results[
      minute_start_min >= w$start_min & minute_start_min < w$end_min
    ]

    expected_minutes <- w$end_min - w$start_min
    complete_window <- nrow(x) == expected_minutes &&
      all(x$complete_calculation_coverage)

    raw_mean <- if (any(!is.na(x$tw_relative_quoted_spread_bps))) {
      mean(x$tw_relative_quoted_spread_bps, na.rm = TRUE)
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }

    window_seconds <- expected_minutes * 60
    usable_seconds <- sum(x$eligible_seconds)
    spread_numerator <- sum(
      x$tw_relative_quoted_spread_bps * x$eligible_seconds,
      na.rm = TRUE
    )
    window_spread <- if (usable_seconds > 0) {
      spread_numerator / usable_seconds
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
    coverage_pct <- 100 * usable_seconds / window_seconds
    passes_coverage <- usable_seconds > 0 &&
      coverage_pct + 1e-10 >= COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_PCT
    passes_strict_coverage <- usable_seconds > 0 &&
      coverage_pct + 1e-10 >= STRICT_COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_PCT

    bid_depth_usable_seconds <- sum(x$bid_depth_usable_seconds)
    ask_depth_usable_seconds <- sum(x$ask_depth_usable_seconds)
    window_bid_depth <- if (bid_depth_usable_seconds > 0) {
      sum(
        x$tw_bid_depth_shares * x$bid_depth_usable_seconds,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) / bid_depth_usable_seconds
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
    window_ask_depth <- if (ask_depth_usable_seconds > 0) {
      sum(
        x$tw_ask_depth_shares * x$ask_depth_usable_seconds,
        na.rm = TRUE
      ) / ask_depth_usable_seconds
    } else {
      NA_real_
    }
    bid_depth_coverage_pct <- 100 * bid_depth_usable_seconds / window_seconds
    ask_depth_coverage_pct <- 100 * ask_depth_usable_seconds / window_seconds
    bid_depth_passes_coverage <- bid_depth_usable_seconds > 0 &&
      bid_depth_coverage_pct + 1e-10 >= COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_PCT
    ask_depth_passes_coverage <- ask_depth_usable_seconds > 0 &&
      ask_depth_coverage_pct + 1e-10 >= COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_PCT

    data.table(
      locked_treatment = unique(x$locked_treatment),
      window = w$window,
      window_start_min = w$start_min,
      window_end_min = w$end_min,
      expected_minutes = expected_minutes,
      observed_minutes = nrow(x),
      complete_quote_minutes = sum(x$complete_quote_coverage),
      complete_calculation_minutes = sum(x$complete_calculation_coverage),
      all_minutes_complete = complete_window,
      mean_of_minute_spreads_bps = raw_mean,
      window_spread_bps = window_spread,
      regression_spread_bps = if (passes_coverage) window_spread else NA_real_,
      window_seconds = window_seconds,
      coverage_pct = coverage_pct,
      passes_coverage = passes_coverage,
      passes_strict_coverage = passes_strict_coverage,
      one_cent_seconds = sum(x$one_cent_seconds),
      one_cent_pct = if (usable_seconds > 0) {
        100 * sum(x$one_cent_seconds) / usable_seconds
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      window_tw_bid_depth_shares = window_bid_depth,
      window_tw_ask_depth_shares = window_ask_depth,
      regression_bid_depth_shares = if (bid_depth_passes_coverage) {
        window_bid_depth
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      regression_ask_depth_shares = if (ask_depth_passes_coverage) {
        window_ask_depth
      } else {
        NA_real_
      },
      valid_seconds = sum(x$valid_seconds),
      locked_seconds = sum(x$locked_seconds),
      crossed_seconds = sum(x$crossed_seconds),
      missing_quote_seconds = sum(x$missing_quote_seconds),
      missing_price_seconds = sum(x$missing_price_seconds),
      invalid_price_seconds = sum(x$invalid_price_seconds),
      ambiguous_price_seconds = sum(x$ambiguous_price_seconds),
      large_spread_seconds = sum(x$large_spread_seconds),
      has_large_spread = sum(x$large_spread_seconds) > 0,
      eligible_seconds = usable_seconds,
      excluded_seconds = window_seconds - usable_seconds,
      bid_depth_usable_seconds = bid_depth_usable_seconds,
      ask_depth_usable_seconds = ask_depth_usable_seconds,
      bid_depth_coverage_pct = bid_depth_coverage_pct,
      ask_depth_coverage_pct = ask_depth_coverage_pct,
      bid_depth_passes_coverage = bid_depth_passes_coverage,
      ask_depth_passes_coverage = ask_depth_passes_coverage,
      bid_depth_passes_strict_coverage = bid_depth_usable_seconds > 0 &&
        bid_depth_coverage_pct + 1e-10 >= STRICT_COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_PCT,
      ask_depth_passes_strict_coverage = ask_depth_usable_seconds > 0 &&
        ask_depth_coverage_pct + 1e-10 >= STRICT_COVERAGE_THRESHOLD_PCT,
      bid_depth_ambiguous_seconds = sum(x$bid_depth_ambiguous_seconds),
      ask_depth_ambiguous_seconds = sum(x$ask_depth_ambiguous_seconds),
      bid_depth_invalid_size_seconds = sum(x$bid_depth_invalid_size_seconds),
      ask_depth_invalid_size_seconds = sum(x$ask_depth_invalid_size_seconds)
    )
  }))
}
```

# 12. Process one ETF-date observation

This wrapper downloads one ETF-date and returns both the 50-minute graph data
and the seven summary windows for the main and robustness treatments.

```{r process-one-function}
process_one <- function(con, row) {
  metadata <- row[, .(
    input_row, ticker, date, anchor_time, day_type, matched_event_date
  )]

  tryCatch({
    anchor_sec <- clock_to_seconds(row$anchor_time)
    global_start <- anchor_sec - 30 * 60
    global_end <- anchor_sec + 20 * 60
    seconds_to_clock(global_start)
    seconds_to_clock(global_end)

    quotes <- fetch_complete_nbbo(
      con, row$ticker, row$date, global_start, global_end
    )
    states <- prepare_quote_states(quotes, anchor_sec)

    minute_results <- rbindlist(list(
      calculate_one_minute_spreads(states, anchor_sec, include_locked = TRUE),
      calculate_one_minute_spreads(states, anchor_sec, include_locked = FALSE)
    ))
    window_results <- rbindlist(
      lapply(
        split(minute_results, by = "locked_treatment", keep.by = TRUE),
        aggregate_minute_windows
      )
    )

    minute_results[, processing_error := ""]
    window_results[, processing_error := ""]

    list(
      minutes = cbind(metadata[rep(1L, nrow(minute_results))], minute_results),
      windows = cbind(metadata[rep(1L, nrow(window_results))], window_results)
    )
  }, error = function(e) {
    message <- conditionMessage(e)
    minute_error <- CJ(
      locked_treatment = c("keep_locked", "exclude_locked"),
      minute_start_min = -30:19
    )
    minute_error[, `:=`(
      minute_end_min = minute_start_min + 1L,
      tw_relative_quoted_spread_bps = NA_real_,
      one_cent_pct = NA_real_,
      tw_bid_depth_shares = NA_real_,
      tw_ask_depth_shares = NA_real_,
      coverage_pct = 0,
      passes_coverage = FALSE,
      passes_strict_coverage = FALSE,
      processing_error = message
    )]

    window_error <- CJ(
      locked_treatment = c("keep_locked", "exclude_locked"),
      window = WINDOWS$window
    )
    window_error <- merge(window_error, WINDOWS, by = "window", sort = FALSE)
    setnames(
      window_error,
      c("start_min", "end_min"),
      c("window_start_min", "window_end_min")
    )
    window_error[, `:=`(
      mean_of_minute_spreads_bps = NA_real_,
      window_spread_bps = NA_real_,
      regression_spread_bps = NA_real_,
      coverage_pct = 0,
      passes_coverage = FALSE,
      passes_strict_coverage = FALSE,
      one_cent_pct = NA_real_,
      window_tw_bid_depth_shares = NA_real_,
      window_tw_ask_depth_shares = NA_real_,
      regression_bid_depth_shares = NA_real_,
      regression_ask_depth_shares = NA_real_,
      all_minutes_complete = FALSE,
      processing_error = message
    )]

    list(
      minutes = cbind(metadata[rep(1L, nrow(minute_error))], minute_error),
      windows = cbind(metadata[rep(1L, nrow(window_error))], window_error)
    )
  })
}
```

# 13. Run offline logic tests

The tests verify carry-in, nanosecond ordering, duplicate-timestamp ambiguity,
locked/crossed treatment, one-cent and depth calculations, usable-second window
weighting, and the 99% coverage rule without accessing WRDS.

```{r self-test}
anchor_test <- 14 * 3600
synthetic_quotes <- data.table(
  time_sec = c(
    13 * 3600 + 20 * 60,
    13 * 3600 + 40 * 60,
    13 * 3600 + 55 * 60,
    14 * 3600,
    14 * 3600 + 5 * 60
  ),
  best_bid = c(99, 100, 102, 101, 102),
  best_ask = c(101, 102, 101, 101, 103),
  best_bidsizeshares = c(1000, 1100, 1200, 1300, 1400),
  best_asksizeshares = c(900, 1000, 1100, 1200, 1300)
)

test_states <- prepare_quote_states(synthetic_quotes, anchor_test)
test_keep <- calculate_one_minute_spreads(
  test_states, anchor_test, include_locked = TRUE
)
test_exclude <- calculate_one_minute_spreads(
  test_states, anchor_test, include_locked = FALSE
)
test_windows <- aggregate_minute_windows(test_keep)

stopifnot(
  nrow(test_keep) == 50,
  nrow(test_exclude) == 50,
  test_keep[minute_start_min == -30, valid_seconds] == 60,
  sum(test_keep[minute_start_min %between% c(-5, -1), crossed_seconds]) == 300,
  test_keep[minute_start_min == 0, locked_seconds] == 60,
  test_keep[minute_start_min == 0, tw_relative_quoted_spread_bps] == 0,
  is.na(test_exclude[
    minute_start_min == 0, tw_relative_quoted_spread_bps
  ]),
  test_windows[window == "0_1", regression_spread_bps] == 0,
  test_windows[window == "1_5", regression_spread_bps] == 0
)

# A half-second crossed interval fails complete coverage but still passes 99%.
coverage_spread <- 10000 * 0.01 / 100.005
coverage_states <- data.table(
  state_start = c(anchor_test, anchor_test + 59.5),
  state_end = c(anchor_test + 59.5, anchor_test + 60),
  state = c("valid", "crossed"),
  spread_bps = c(coverage_spread, NA_real_),
  dollar_spread = c(0.01, NA_real_),
  bid_depth_shares = c(1000, NA_real_),
  ask_depth_shares = c(2000, NA_real_),
  bid_depth_ambiguous = FALSE,
  ask_depth_ambiguous = FALSE,
  large_spread = FALSE
)
coverage_minutes <- calculate_one_minute_spreads(
  coverage_states, anchor_test, include_locked = TRUE
)
coverage_windows <- aggregate_minute_windows(coverage_minutes)

stopifnot(
  !coverage_minutes[minute_start_min == 0, complete_calculation_coverage],
  abs(coverage_minutes[minute_start_min == 0, coverage_pct] -
        100 * 59.5 / 60) < 1e-10,
  coverage_windows[window == "0_1", passes_coverage],
  !coverage_windows[window == "0_1", passes_strict_coverage],
  !is.na(coverage_windows[window == "0_1", regression_spread_bps]),
  abs(coverage_windows[window == "0_1", one_cent_pct] - 100) < 1e-10,
  coverage_windows[window == "0_1", window_tw_bid_depth_shares] == 1000,
  coverage_windows[window == "0_1", window_tw_ask_depth_shares] == 2000
)

# Same full timestamp: price agreement preserves spread; a conflicting size
# removes only that side's depth. Price disagreement creates an excluded state.
duplicate_quotes <- data.table(
  time_m = c(
    "13:30:00", "14:00:10", "14:00:10", "14:00:20", "14:00:20"
  ),
  time_m_nano = c(0L, 100L, 100L, 200L, 200L),
  time_sec = c(
    anchor_test - 1800, anchor_test + 10.0000001,
    anchor_test + 10.0000001, anchor_test + 20.0000002,
    anchor_test + 20.0000002
  ),
  best_bid = c(100, 100, 100, 100, 100.01),
  best_ask = c(100.01, 100.01, 100.01, 100.01, 100.02),
  best_bidsizeshares = c(1000, 1000, 1200, 1000, 1000),
  best_asksizeshares = c(900, 900, 900, 900, 900)
)
duplicate_states <- prepare_quote_states(duplicate_quotes, anchor_test)

stopifnot(
  duplicate_states[state_start > anchor_test + 9 &
                     state_start < anchor_test + 11,
                   bid_depth_ambiguous],
  !duplicate_states[state_start > anchor_test + 9 &
                      state_start < anchor_test + 11,
                    ask_depth_ambiguous],
  duplicate_states[state_start > anchor_test + 19 &
                     state_start < anchor_test + 21,
                   state] == "ambiguous_price"
)

message("Offline self-tests passed.")
coverage_windows[window == "0_1"]
```

# 14. Run the XLK live test

This disabled chunk produces 100 minute rows (50 minutes times two locked-quote
treatments) and 14 window rows (seven windows times two treatments).

```{r xlk-live-test, eval=FALSE}
con <- connect_wrds()
xlk_input <- input[
  ticker == "XLK" &
  date == as.IDate("2019-01-30") &
  anchor_time == "14:00:00"
]
stopifnot(nrow(xlk_input) == 1L)

xlk_result <- process_one(con, xlk_input[1])
xlk_result$minutes
xlk_result$windows

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)
```

# 15. Run the full batch

Every input row is processed independently. A failed ticker-date is recorded
and later rows continue.

```{r full-batch, eval=FALSE}
input_file <- file.choose()
input <- validate_input(fread(input_file, colClasses = "character"))

con <- connect_wrds()

result_list <- lapply(seq_len(nrow(input)), function(i) {
  message("Processing row ", i, "/", nrow(input),
          ": ", input$ticker[i], " ", input$date[i])
  process_one(con, input[i])
})

minute_results <- rbindlist(
  lapply(result_list, `[[`, "minutes"), fill = TRUE
)
window_results <- rbindlist(
  lapply(result_list, `[[`, "windows"), fill = TRUE
)

DBI::dbDisconnect(con)

View(window_results)
```

# 16. Write output files

`minute_spreads.csv` supplies the 50-minute graph data, one-cent diagnostic, and
minute depth measures. `spreads.csv` supplies the baseline, anticipation, and
five post-announcement windows. The diagnostics file combines coverage,
excluded-duration, ambiguity, large-spread, depth, and error fields at both
resolutions.

```{r write-outputs, eval=FALSE}
output_dir <- "run_output/full_batch"
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

minute_spread_columns <- c(
  "input_row", "ticker", "date", "anchor_time", "day_type",
  "matched_event_date", "locked_treatment", "minute_start_min",
  "minute_end_min", "tw_relative_quoted_spread_bps", "one_cent_pct",
  "tw_bid_depth_shares", "tw_ask_depth_shares", "coverage_pct",
  "bid_depth_coverage_pct", "ask_depth_coverage_pct"
)
window_spread_columns <- c(
  "input_row", "ticker", "date", "anchor_time", "day_type",
  "matched_event_date", "locked_treatment", "window",
  "window_start_min", "window_end_min", "mean_of_minute_spreads_bps",
  "window_spread_bps", "regression_spread_bps", "coverage_pct",
  "passes_coverage", "passes_strict_coverage", "one_cent_pct",
  "window_tw_bid_depth_shares", "window_tw_ask_depth_shares",
  "regression_bid_depth_shares", "regression_ask_depth_shares",
  "bid_depth_coverage_pct", "ask_depth_coverage_pct",
  "bid_depth_passes_coverage", "ask_depth_passes_coverage",
  "all_minutes_complete"
)

fwrite(
  minute_results[, ..minute_spread_columns],
  file.path(output_dir, "minute_spreads.csv"),
  na = ""
)
fwrite(
  window_results[, ..window_spread_columns],
  file.path(output_dir, "spreads.csv"),
  na = ""
)

minute_diagnostics <- copy(minute_results)
minute_diagnostics[, `:=`(
  output_level = "minute",
  period = paste0(minute_start_min, "_", minute_end_min)
)]
window_diagnostics <- copy(window_results)
window_diagnostics[, `:=`(
  output_level = "window",
  period = window
)]

fwrite(
  rbindlist(
    list(minute_diagnostics, window_diagnostics),
    fill = TRUE,
    use.names = TRUE
  ),
  file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics.csv"),
  na = ""
)
```

# 17. Interpret the diagnostics

- `locked_treatment` identifies the main (`keep_locked`) or robustness
  (`exclude_locked`) result.
- `coverage_pct` is 100 times spread-usable seconds divided by total window
  seconds. `passes_coverage` uses 99%; `passes_strict_coverage` uses 99.9%.
- `regression_spread_bps` uses the usable-second-weighted `window_spread_bps`
  whenever 99% coverage passes, even if `all_minutes_complete` is false.
- `mean_of_minute_spreads_bps` is retained only as a transparent comparison to
  the earlier unweighted-minute method.
- `one_cent_pct` is the percentage of spread-usable seconds with a dollar
  spread within `1e-7` dollars of one cent.
- `tw_bid_depth_shares` and `tw_ask_depth_shares` are side-specific minute
  measures. Window depth is weighted by that side's usable depth seconds.
- `bid_depth_coverage_pct` and `ask_depth_coverage_pct` are reported separately.
- `crossed_seconds`, `missing_quote_seconds`, `missing_price_seconds`,
  `invalid_price_seconds`, and `ambiguous_price_seconds` retain exclusions by
  reason. No excluded interval is filled with an earlier valid quote.
- `bid_depth_ambiguous_seconds` and `ask_depth_ambiguous_seconds` identify
  same-full-timestamp conflicts affecting each side's depth.
- `large_spread_seconds` and `has_large_spread` flag relative spreads above
  100 basis points for review; they are not automatically deleted.
- `processing_error` records a failed ticker-date without stopping the batch.

The 50 one-minute observations are used for descriptive graphs. The five
post-announcement windows (`0-1`, `1-5`, `5-10`, `10-15`, and `15-20`) and the
20-minute baseline are used to construct the regression variables.

# 18. Source-field interpretation

- NYSE describes the Daily TAQ NBBO file as a record of quotes that cause the
  NBBO to change. Quote conditions determine whether source quotes qualify for
  BBO calculation.
- The inspected WRDS `complete_nbbo_20190130` table contains condition fields
  but no sequence or cancellation/correction field. This pipeline therefore
  does not apply an unsupported extra condition or cancellation filter.
- `best_bidsizeshares` and `best_asksizeshares` are displayed shares associated
  with the quote credited with setting each side of the NBBO. They are not the
  sum of all exchange depth available at the same best price.
- Additional quote-condition filters should be added only after their intended
  economic interpretation and the construction of `complete_nbbo` are verified
  for every sample year.

Method and field references:

- [Project methodology: Liquidity Measurement and Timing](https://docs.google.com/document/d/10g4mS0OB0uAShr_xz6ZNIYwe6qJSnFu1Qmqj03CSF_Q/edit)
- [NYSE Daily TAQ Client Specification](https://www.nyse.com/publicdocs/nyse/data/Daily_TAQ_Client_Spec_v4.1b.pdf)
